meaningKo: 어려운 상황을 견디다, 힘든 결정을 내리다
exampleEn: I didn't want to start studying for the exam, but I had to bite the bullet and get it done.
exampleKo: 시험 공부를 시작하고 싶지 않았지만, 결국 이를 악물고 해야 했어.
gameExamples: After weeks of procrastination, I finally decided to bite the bullet and ask my boss for a raise.
Even though I was anxious about the surgery, I knew I had to bite the bullet for my health.
She was nervous about the presentation, but she had to bite the bullet and step up to lead the meeting.
